# ReorthogonalizeVectorSet

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/ReorthogonalizeVectorSet`

```text
ReorthogonalizeVectorSet, version 0.01

Usage: ReorthogonalizeVectorSet [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -b, --basis : name of the file that contains the vector files of the orthonormalized input basis (InputBasis) and the files of the vectors to orthonalize upon (OrthogonalBasis)
    -o, --ortho-basis : alternative input for orthogonal basis vectors(overrides basis file) (multiple arguments)
    -i, --input-basis : alternative input for known input basis vectors (multiple arguments)
    --error : bound above which vectors are considered as linearly independent (default value = 1e-10)
    --vector-prefix : prefix to use for each vector of the basis

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
